description: Lollipop map of all ClinVar KRT9 variants by classification against the domain architecture
code:
import requests, re, json, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, time, pandas as pd
from collections import Counter
E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
ids=requests.get(E+"esearch.fcgi",params={"db":"clinvar","term":'KRT9[gene]',"retmax":500,"retmode":"json"},timeout=60).json()["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
recs=[]
for i in range(0,len(ids),200):
    s=requests.get(E+"esummary.fcgi",params={"db":"clinvar","id":",".join(ids[i:i+200]),"retmode":"json"},timeout=90).json()["result"]
    recs+= [v for k,v in s.items() if k!="uids"]
    time.sleep(0.4)
rows=[]
for v in recs:
    t=v.get("title",""); sig=(v.get("germline_classification") or {}).get("description","")
    m=re.search(r"\(p\.([A-Z][a-z]{2})(\d+)([A-Za-z=]+)\)",t)
    if m: rows.append((int(m.group(2)),m.group(3),sig))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["pos","mut","sig"]).drop_duplicates()
path=df[df.sig.str.contains("athogenic")&~df.sig.str.contains("Conflicting")]
ben =df[df.sig.str.contains("enign")]
vus =df[df.sig.str.contains("Uncertain")]

fig,(ax,ax2)=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,7),gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[2.2,1]})

# domain track
dom=[("head",1,152,"#e3e3e3"),("coil 1A",153,188,"#b03030"),("L1",189,207,"#f4f4f4"),
     ("coil 1B",208,299,"#8aa9c9"),("L12",300,322,"#f4f4f4"),("coil 2",323,461,"#2f6f4e"),
     ("tail",462,623,"#e3e3e3")]
for nm,a,b,c in dom:
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((a,-0.45),b-a+1,0.9,color=c,ec="white",lw=0.8))
    if b-a>18: ax.text((a+b)/2,0,nm,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8.5,
                       color="white" if c in("#b03030","#2f6f4e","#8aa9c9") else "black")
# helix boundary motif shading
for a,b,lab in [(153,172,"helix initiation motif"),(440,461,"helix termination motif")]:
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((a,-0.45),b-a+1,3.6,color="#b03030",alpha=0.10,zorder=0))
    ax.text((a+b)/2,3.35,lab,ha="center",fontsize=8.5,color="#b03030")

def lolli(ax,positions,y0,color,marker,label):
    cnt=Counter(positions)
    for p,n in cnt.items():
        ax.plot([p,p],[y0,y0+0.25+0.14*n],color=color,lw=0.9,zorder=2)
        ax.plot(p,y0+0.25+0.14*n,marker,color=color,ms=4+1.2*n,zorder=3)
    ax.plot([],[],marker,color=color,label=f"{label} (n={len(positions)})")

lolli(ax,list(path.pos),0.45,"#c0392b","o","ClinVar pathogenic / likely pathogenic")
lolli(ax,list(vus.pos),-0.45,"#999999","v","uncertain significance")
lolli(ax,list(ben.pos),-0.45,"#3b78a8","v","benign / likely benign")
ax.set_xlim(0,630); ax.set_ylim(-2.6,3.8); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("residue position in KRT9 (P35527)")
ax.legend(frameon=False,fontsize=9,loc="upper left",ncol=1)
ax.set_title("ClinVar pathogenic KRT9 alleles fall almost exclusively in the two helix boundary motifs")
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.invert_yaxis()
for sp in ["top","right","left"]: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

# enrichment bar
cats=["pathogenic /\nlikely pathogenic","uncertain\nsignificance","benign /\nlikely benign"]
def fm(d): return 100*sum(1 for p in d.pos if 153<=p<=172 or 440<=p<=461)/len(d)
vals=[fm(path),fm(vus),fm(ben)]; ns=[len(path),len(vus),len(ben)]
bars=ax2.bar(cats,vals,color=["#c0392b","#999999","#3b78a8"],width=0.55)
ax2.axhline(6.7,ls="--",color="k",lw=1)
ax2.text(2.45,8.5,"6.7% expected if uniform",fontsize=8.5,ha="right")
for b,v,n in zip(bars,vals,ns):
    ax2.text(b.get_x()+b.get_width()/2,v+3,f"{v:.0f}%  (n={n})",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax2.set_ylabel("percent of variants in\nhelix boundary motifs"); ax2.set_ylim(0,112)
for sp in ["top","right"]: ax2.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
ax2.set_title("14.2-fold enrichment, binomial p = 5.2e-24, with VUS and benign variants as internal controls",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
